sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • U.S. and Iran reach framework agreement (MOU signed today, formal signing scheduled for 6/19): 60-day ceasefire extension + reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, but the terms were blasted by the community as “surrender-style” — the U.S. will provide Iran with roughly 300 billion in reconstruction funds, while the strait will first allow free passage for 60 days before “navigation service fees” resume. The risk-on rally continued: SPY +1.83% @755.2 (intraday high 756.7, stuck below the 760 ATH all day and failed to break through), QQQ +3.14% @744 continued to lead, while DIA was only +1.22%.
  • Israel openly pushes back, creating the biggest tail risk: Netanyahu held a press conference in the afternoon, with the community closely watching his remarks (“Does BB have calls or puts” became the hottest meme of the session); Israeli officials called it a “disastrous deal,” and the IDF reportedly advanced 2–3 km into villages in southern Lebanon. Iran’s president also said “a final agreement has not yet been reached,” pouring cold water on one-sided optimism.
  • SPCX continued rising on its second day of trading, +16.2% @187.3 (intraday high 188.75, two-day cumulative gain of about 36%), with a market cap of about 2.4 trillion, already above META, approaching MSFT, and higher than TSMC — the debate over “no difference between 2 trillion and 10 trillion” vs “bubble” reached fever pitch; options begin trading Tuesday, becoming the biggest suspense point for the entire community.
  • The memory faith pays off: MU +11.65% @1095.6, approaching 1100, with earnings next week drawing near; SNDK +6.2%, holding above 2100. AI/semiconductors saw a full-blown frenzy: MRVL +10.7%, breaking 300; NBIS +12.2% @260; AMD +7.1% @548; ARM +8.8%; NVDA +3.5% @212 (reports say it is issuing debt for financing).
  • Oil market continues to be shorted: USO -3.81% @120.7, as the market bets the strait’s reopening will bring oversupply. FOX -15.2% @50 (FIFA broadcast + acquisition news); ROKU received an acquisition offer but failed to close green.
  • Macro focus this week: FOMC rate decision on 6/16–17, Chair Warsh’s debut, with the probability of rates staying unchanged at about 97%; language is expected to shift from dovish to neutral, and the 6/17 2:30 PM press conference is key. There are also market rumors that the Bank of Japan may raise rates.

社区氛围：极度贪婪，近乎疯狂的全面看涨——上周高喊“世界末日”的空头被系统性地消灭和羞辱，“推销新闻”的剧本完全失败，社区将唯一的下行风险完全归咎于内塔尼亚胡破坏协议，而不是基本面。

恐惧/贪婪等级：贪婪 78–82。大盘非常兴奋，但三个主要分歧依然存在——IWM仅+0.6%、收益率上升和交易量低——显然与大盘的兴奋不同步。

情绪与实际价格走势：罕见的错位——尽管SPY实际上上涨了近2%，QQQ上涨了3%以上，但评论中充满了诸如“theta烧死我”、“为什么不上涨”和“平淡乏味”等抱怨，因为许多在高点附近买入的0DTE看涨期权都被横向走势压垮了。一条高票评论“读到这里的评论，你会认为 SPY 下跌了 2%”，准确地体现了这种“赚钱但仍然认为还不够”的贪婪心态。
